description: Returns a number that is rounded down to the nearest integer or to the nearest multiple of significance. The number is always rounded down regardless of its sign.

params.description: The numeric value to round down.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The multiple of significance to round down to. If it is omitted, the default value of 1 is used. If it is set to zero, the function returns 0.
params.name: arg2

signature: FLOOR_PRECISE(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
